subject: ClearMark onboarding: PO-number stitch, spend cap safety-net and line-item alignment
messages:
From: Elena Soto <elena@clearmark.io>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Haining <tom.h@clearmark.io>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: ClearMark onboarding — provisional PO codes and spend cap question

Hi Rishi,

Thanks again for the walkthrough last week. Attached is our completed onboarding form and the provisional PO code list you requested (clear_mark_provisional_pocodes.csv). A couple of items we need clarified before we can finalize internal approvals: 

- The provisional PO codes you issued (P-6603 / P-6604) map to two line bundles, but our procurement system expects per-SKU items rather than grouped bundles. Can Redwood provide a recommended SKU-level mapping, or should we supply a full SKU list?
- Our finance team pushed back on the initial spend cap of $150,000 for Q3 — ClearMark will need an uplift to $210,000 to match expected usage for the pilot.

We can sign the contract with the provisional codes in place if there's a short-term safety-net for spend overruns (either temporary cap increase or an approval path that won't block calls). Can Monica or someone on your procurement side propose an operational fallback for the first 30 days?

I've attached the onboarding PDF and provisional pocode CSV. Happy to hop on 30 minutes if that speeds things up.

Best,
Elena Soto
Head of Operations, ClearMark Inc.
Elena Soto | elena@clearmark.io | +1 415-555-0198

Attachments: ClearMark_Onboarding_Form.pdf (PDF), clear_mark_provisional_pocodes.csv (CSV)

From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 10:08:00 -0700
Subject: Fwd: ClearMark onboarding — provisional PO codes and spend cap question

Monica / Ben — forwarding ClearMark's note. TL;DR: vendor needs SKU-level line mapping and a temporary uplift from 150k -> 210k for the pilot, or an operational safety-net that won't block their calls.

Monica: can procurement produce the SKU mapping sheet (we have a template) and tell me whether we can offer a 30-day soft cap override for new customers on Dedicated? If not, what's the quickest approval route?

Ben: FYI on potential ARR impact and whether a credit/commit tweak is reasonable for a pilot. If we can give a temporary overspend approval (billing holds until review) that could keep them live and reduce friction.

Quick notes on cadence: Elena is ready to sign once the cap question is answered. They want minimal call disruption during the ramp.

Thanks,
Rishi

> On Mon, 22 Jun 2026 09:12:00 -0700, Elena Soto <elena@clearmark.io> wrote:
> > (original vendor message attached)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Soto <elena@clearmark.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 22 Jun 2026 13:45:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearMark onboarding — provisional PO codes and spend cap question

Hi Elena — thanks for the docs and the clear summary. Short answers below, and I attached an initial SKU-level mapping (sku_line_mapping_v1.xlsx) that aligns your provisional codes to line-by-line items.

1) SKU mapping: we populated the first pass using the bundles you sent. Please review the sheet and confirm any SKUs that should be split differently. If you can return the sheet with your internal SKU IDs we will reissue line items to match your ledger.

2) Spend cap / safety-net: Redwood can offer a 30-day provisional uplift to $210,000 for pilot customers, with the following caveats:
   - The uplift is timeboxed to 30 days from date of first invoice.
   - Any usage beyond the uplift will be charged at list rates but we will not block API traffic; we will instead put an automated billing review hold and notify both parties for manual sign-off.
   - If ClearMark needs a longer-term increase, we need procurement approval and a short addendum (DocuSign link to follow).

Operationally, we will:
- Reissue PO numbers at the SKU level once you confirm the attached mapping.
- Enable a billing hold policy (non-blocking) for the 30-day uplift so traffic continues.

Tom/Elena — can you confirm the SKU sheet by EOD tomorrow and we will rerun issuance?

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference
monica_patel@redwood.ai

Attachment: sku_line_mapping_v1.xlsx

From: Tom Haining <tom.h@clearmark.io>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Elena Soto <elena@clearmark.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 23 Jun 2026 10:07:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearMark onboarding — provisional PO codes and spend cap question

Monica — thanks for the quick turnaround and the SKU mapping. I've attached our finance's exported SKU list with internal IDs (clearmark_skus_export.csv) and marked a few SKUs where the bundle split needs to be finer.

We confirm we accept the 30-day provisional uplift to $210,000 under the non-blocking billing hold approach. Please proceed to reissue the PO numbers at the SKU level.

We'd prefer the reissued PO list to include a short note per line that maps to our internal product code so our ledger ingestion is automatic. Is that something your team can append?

Elena and I are around for a short call if helpful — otherwise we'll review your updated issuance and sign the addendum.

Best,
Tom Haining
Head of Finance, ClearMark Inc.

Attachments: clearmark_skus_export.csv (CSV)

From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Tom Haining <tom.h@clearmark.io>, Elena Soto <elena@clearmark.io>
Cc: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 08:21:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearMark onboarding — provisional PO codes and spend cap question

Tom/Elena — attached is the reissued PO export (reissued_pocodes_for_clearmark.csv) — we generated unique PO lines that include your internal product codes in the "vendor_sku_ref" column so ingestion should be straightforward. I also flagged three lines where quantities were rounded; please confirm the quantities for SKU CM-44, CM-95, CM-102.

Operational notes:
- The 30-day provisional uplift is active as of the first invoice date; billing holds will allow traffic to continue while finance teams reconcile overages.
- I've created a short Jira ticket to track any downstream ledger mismatches: SUP-1124. Please use that ticket for any correction requests so our finance engineers can patch the ingestion pipeline.

Ben — tagging you on the ticket in case the uplift impacts our Q3 committed capacity planning.

Thanks — once you confirm the three quantities we'll mark this onboarding complete and Monica's team will close the loop on PO issuance.

Regards,
Monica Patel
Senior Procurement Manager | Redwood Inference

Attachment: reissued_pocodes_for_clearmark.csv (CSV)

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Haining <tom.h@clearmark.io>, Elena Soto <elena@clearmark.io>
Date: Wed, 24 Jun 2026 15:32:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: ClearMark onboarding — provisional PO codes and spend cap question

Quick confirmation from finance side: the 30-day provisional uplift to $210,000 is approved for this pilot. We'll monitor daily spend and ping both teams if we approach 85% of the uplift.

Two asks for operational hygiene: 
- Tom/Elena: please confirm the quantities Monica flagged (CM-44, CM-95, CM-102) by EOD tomorrow so we can finalize ingestion.
- Monica: can you add a short note to the export header that includes the DocuSign addendum ID once issued? That makes downstream reconciliation much smoother.

Once the quantities are confirmed we'll close SUP-1124 and move ClearMark to Active onboarding.

Thanks,
Ben Carter
Manager, Revenue Operations | Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwood.ai

(automated attachments: reissued_pocodes_for_clearmark.csv referenced above)
